description: This source file implements signal handling for suspend, conceal, focus, freeze, stop, and low memory events in the starboard shared signal namespace, including setting up signal handlers, blocking/unblocking signals, and managing a dedicated signal handler thread.

classes.name: SignalHandlerThread
classes.description: A thread class that unblocks all signals and runs indefinitely to handle signals.

methods.name: SignalMask
methods.description: Sets the signal mask for a list of signals with a specified action (block or unblock).

methods.name: SetSignalHandler
methods.description: Sets a specific signal handler for a given signal.

methods.name: Conceal
methods.description: Blocks all signals, logs the caught signal, requests concealment, then unblocks signals.

methods.name: Focus
methods.description: Blocks all signals, logs the caught signal, and requests application focus.

methods.name: Freeze
methods.description: Blocks all signals, logs the caught signal, and requests system freeze.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Blocks all signals, logs the caught signal, and stops the application.

methods.name: LowMemory
methods.description: Blocks all signals, logs the caught signal, and injects a low memory event.

methods.name: Ignore
methods.description: Logs the signal, dumps the stack, and flushes logs, ignoring the signal.

methods.name: ConfigureSignalHandlerThread
methods.description: Starts or joins the dedicated signal handler thread.
